text:
morgan: Heads up — releasebot skipped a bump on the 1.4.x line because the diff was marked docs/telemetry only, but the PR also introduced a 'migration' feature flag. /cc @release-manager

deploy-bot: publish-skip: No semantic change detected. No patch bump. (rule: docs/telemetry => skip) :robot_face:

vivian: The migration flag controls v1->v2 runtime behavior. Default is OFF, but this still feels like a behavior-affecting change for some Dedicated tenants.

kevin: If a toggle exists that can change runtime behavior, we treat it as a semantic change for pinned customers. They expect patch bumps.

sasha: Is the flag enabled in prod anywhere? The PR rolled but default=false everywhere.

morgan: Rolled to staging and test only. Default is off in prod, but Dedicated tenants can flip it in their config. That means an opt-in could surface diffs for pinned installs.

quinn: Could we use buildmeta instead (1.4.2+featflag) to avoid incrementing patch? That keeps consumers aware without bumping semver.

release-manager: We don't allow buildmeta on stable channels — our tooling (and some package comparators) strip/ignore buildmetadata which breaks pin resolution for enterprise.

ops-oncall: Also, retroactively changing tenant pins from our side is not safe without CS/ops approval. We shouldn't rely on tenant-side toggles to be coordinated.

kevin: Given the risk profile, my vote is to force a patch bump. Low risk and clear for customers.

sasha: +1 patch. Safer and aligns with our contract for Dedicated.

morgan: Can someone run the force-patch flow? Options: use `/release force-patch` or open a tiny release PR that increments patch.

release-bot: deploybot note: Forcing patch bump requires human-approved release. Add `/release force-patch 1.4.2` in this thread or open a release PR with changelog. Release-manager must approve.

vivian: I'll open the release PR now (keeping changelog same, bumping patch).

quinn: Add a short line in the notes: "migration flag default remains OFF; patch bumped to communicate potential behavior change for Dedicated tenants."

morgan: Also filing a small playbook update: clarify that default-changing feature flags count as behavior changes when they can be toggled per-tenant.

kevin: Filed: https://go/redwood/ops/semver-playbook#feature-flags — added suggested wording.

sasha: :thumbsup:

release-manager: I'll review and approve the PR once the changelog entry is present.

deploy-bot: CI: release PR #4521 created by vivian. Tests passing. Deploy window scheduled for tonight 02:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: Confirmed: no infra changes, rollback plan OK.

morgan: Locking it down — will trigger /release during the window. Thanks everyone :shipit:
